name: secure-contact-center-control-plane
description: Provider-neutral control plane for secure contact-center operations.

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @relayops/api && npm run build --workspace @relayops/web
scripts.check: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev --workspace @relayops/api" "npm run dev --workspace @relayops/web"
